_note: Tips introduce the game as the player goes (spec section 14). They show in this order, one at a time, while their condition holds. Conditions are named in game/tips.gd. {placeholders} are filled from rules.json.

tips.text: Build anti-air first. Each one shoots at missiles aimed within {aa_radius} hexes of it, up to {aa_engagements} a round.
Research radar next. Anti-air inside a radar's range hits {acc_radar}% of the time instead of {acc}%. Build a lab, then select it or click its beaker to choose research.
Pick a launcher on the left, then click a hex on the enemy space to aim it. The enemy island is under fog: missiles have to find its coast first. Undo is free.
The number on a potential base counts its hits. A base falls at {base_hits} hits. A decoy is exposed when it reaches {decoy_reveal_hits} hits.
Something of yours is damaged. Select it and press Repair. A damaged weapon stays out of action until it is repaired.
You don't have the fuel to fire every launcher. Each refinery adds {refinery_fuel} fuel a round.
